student_learning_goal: I can sort by 3 attributes using a tree diagram.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can sort by 3 attributes using a tree diagram.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dot in the top-right with a magnifying glass and 3-column notebook. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.part_title: Part 1: Place 8 items in a tree.
parts.student_instructions: Place 8 items at the right leaves of the tree (colour x shape x size).
parts.visual_layout: A 3-level tree with 8 leaves and 8 items to place.

image_placeholders.description: A 3-level tree diagram for Grade 3 worksheet, B&W line art. Top: 'Items'. Level 1 branches: RED/BLUE. Level 2: SQUARE/CIRCLE under each. Level 3: BIG/SMALL under each. 8 leaf positions. Below the tree: 8 items to assign (red big square, etc.).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P1_TREE at Part 1: keywords name the visual elements.

parts.answer_key: Each item placed at the leaf matching its 3 attributes.

parts.student_instructions: Read the pre-built tree. Identify 4 specific items at named leaves.

image_placeholders.description: A pre-built 3-level tree diagram for Grade 3 worksheet with leaves labelled. Below: 4 questions like 'What's at the RED+SQUARE+SMALL leaf?'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P2_READ at Part 2: keywords name the visual elements.

parts.answer_key: Sample names of items at each named leaf.

parts.student_instructions: Pick 3 attributes for your toys. Make a tree.

image_placeholders.description: A blank workspace for Grade 3 worksheet. Above: 'Attribute 1: ___ Attribute 2: ___ Attribute 3: ___'. Below: blank space for tree.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P3_BLANK at Part 3: keywords name the activity.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, plan a 4-attribute tree. How many leaves?
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 consolidation. Use Part 1 as diagnostic — children placing items at correct leaves.
